library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```{r}
antibiotic <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(antibiotic))
```
```{r}
ggplot(antibiotic, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") + 
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID (standardised antibiotic consumption)") + 
  ggtitle("Antibiotic consumption by date")
```
